_readme: Copy this file to 'agent-config.json' (git-ignored) and edit the values.
It holds personal preferences only — never put API keys, tokens, or
passwords here. Agents are allowed to read this file; they are not allowed
to read secret stores such as .env or config.json.
When agent-config.json is absent, agents fall back to the defaults
documented in global-instructions/ and ask before assuming an identity.
External skills live in their own repositories, cloned anywhere on this
machine. Map each skill name (the 'name' in its SKILL.md) to the local
checkout that holds SKILL.md at its root; the linker scripts then link it
like a skill from skills/global/. Paths are absolute or start with ~/,
Leave 'external' empty when you use none.
